subject: Deployment access alignment: SSO/SCIM, service accounts & IP constraints
body:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@finsecure.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: CISO Team <security@finsecure.com>, Procurement <procurement@finsecure.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:12:45 -0700
Subject: Redwood access requirements for pilot deployment

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team liked the latency profile. Before we kick off the pilot next Monday, security and procurement asked me to confirm a few access items so we can complete the PO and network approvals. High level asks:

- SSO integration (SAML 2.0) and a rough timeline for go-live.
- SCIM user provisioning: which attributes you require and whether we can scope down to groups.
- IP allowlist for the hosted endpoints and any stable egress IP ranges.
- Service account model for automated jobs and whether keys rotate automatically.

Can you provide a short checklist and any templates we can share with our compliance team? Also looping in our CISO (security@finsecure.com) and procurement.

Best,
Sanjay
Director of Cloud Platform
FinSecure

---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@finsecure.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 11:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood access requirements for pilot deployment

Hi Sanjay — great to hear. Attached is a concise onboarding checklist and a template for IP allowlist entries. High-level answers in-line below, and I included next steps at the bottom.

- SSO/SAML: We support SAML 2.0 IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows. Typical timeline for pilot: 3 business days to validate metadata and assertion mapping, plus one day for smoke tests. We request an IdP metadata XML and one test user in your sandbox tenant.

- SCIM: We support SCIM 2.0 for full user + group sync. Minimum required attributes: userName, name.givenName, name.familyName, emails[type eq "work"].value, active. Optional: displayName, groups. We'll send a sample attribute map.

- IP allowlists: For hosted, we provide a set of stable egress/ingress IP ranges (not per-request dynamic). We'll provide a /24-range set and a backup range. For Dedicated or Private deployments we can provide fixed addresses per-customer.

- Service accounts: We issue scoped service accounts for programmatic access. Keys are short-lived by default (30 days) and rotate via our management API; we also support certificate-based authentication for on-prem.

Next steps (proposal):
1) You share IdP metadata and a sandbox test user (SAML) — target: Tue 11/3 EOD.
2) FinSecure returns completed IP template — Tue 11/3.
3) Redwood provides SCIM attribute map and test SCIM endpoint — Wed 11/4.
4) Kickoff smoke test session — Thu 11/5 (30–60m).

I attached: redwood-onboard-checklist.pdf and ip-allowlist-template.txt. Marissa will follow up on SCIM mapping.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Customer Success Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-onboard-checklist.pdf (application/pdf), ip-allowlist-template.txt (text/plain)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 08:27:05 -0700
Subject: Internal: SCIM attribute map & service account notes for FinSecure

Marcus — quick internal note to capture what we want to push to Sanjay tomorrow:

- SCIM: I'll attach scim-attribute-map.csv (attributes + example values). We should recommend initially syncing only active users in the "engineering" and "platform" groups to reduce scope.
- Service accounts: for their scheduled batch jobs, suggest using one service account per job with role boundaries (read-only embeddings vs. full model invoke). Include a sample policy snippet.
- Audit logs: call out that admin actions (key rotation, user deprovision) are stored for 365 days by default; they can request longer retention as an add-on.

I'll put the CSV in the Drive link and ping them with a copy.

—Marissa
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: scim-attribute-map.csv (text/csv)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 10:05:30 -0700
Subject: RE: Internal: SCIM attribute map & service account notes for FinSecure

Adding IP allowlist specifics and a small decision matrix for the kickoff:

IP allowlist options:
- Hosted (shared infra): provide range set A (preferred for pilot), supports TLS and mTLS for control plane.
- Dedicated pool (reserved): provide single /24; requires Procurement sign-off for capacity.
- Private (VPC): bring-your-own endpoints; we provide peering docs.

Decision matrix (pilot):
- If FinSecure cannot accommodate a shared range in corporate firewall, move to Dedicated trial (longer procurement).
- If they require mTLS for every request, confirm client cert rotation cadence; we can support mTLS but need CA pinning details.

Also flag: they asked about org policies. Recommend enabling conditional access for service accounts (IP binding + time windows) and creating a small RBAC matrix:
- Admins: user provisioning, key rotation
- Operators: deploy/manage routing policies
- Auditors: read-only logs

I'll be on the kickoff to validate their firewall rules.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Product Manager, Identity & Access
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 14:18:40 -0700
Subject: RE: Internal: SCIM attribute map & service account notes for FinSecure

Quick technical confirmation for the thread:
- SCIM: we can map FinSecure's groups to our internal roles; recommend starting with a single "redwood-user" group and then expand. Enforce SCIM PATCH with ETag checks.
- SAML assertions: require NameID format urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress; recommend including assertion consumer service (ACS) endpoints for both prod and staging.
- Service accounts: keys will be issued via our API. We'll provide a one-click rotate mechanism in the console and an API endpoint (/v1/service-accounts/{id}/rotate).

I'll join the smoke test to validate assertion flows.

—Jonas
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
